mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing cenobamate plasma concentrations and CNS effects, while cenobamate induces CYP3A4, potentially reducing turmeric bioavailability.
action: Monitor for increased cenobamate adverse effects (dizziness, ataxia, diplopia); consider cenobamate dose adjustment if turmeric supplementation is added; counsel on concurrent use risks.
